newsitem.title: CANADA: Moore Corp says unit wins US$300 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Moore Corp says unit wins US$300 mln deal.

text.p: Moore Corp Ltd said on Wednesday its Moore U.S.A. Inc unit won a five-year, US$300 million contract to provide St. Louis-based AmeriNet with print and digital technologies and services.
Moore said the contract guarantees to cut AmeriNet's members' overall business communications costs associated with print and electronic documents.

AmeriNet negotiates volume discounts with suppliers on behalf of more than 6,200 healthcare organizations including hospitals, medical group practices, surgery centers, long-term care and other non-hospital facilities, Moore said.
